concerns.text: User Story 1 has functional requirements (FR-001, FR-002) but no associated Success Criteria. Every story must be backed by at least one SC (see lens rules).
SC-004 references the runtime constraint but does not name a user story it validates. It is an orphaned success criterion.
SC-005 references power‑analysis reporting but no user story is linked; it is an orphaned success criterion.

The Edge Cases section states “The system MUST perform power analysis and report calculated power and margin of error,” yet no functional requirement (FR‑xxx) captures this capability. A missing FR creates a gap in the functional spec.
